request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; administrator confirmation expected within 30 days of enactment.
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent reserve-ratio mechanics and safety zones
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and BTCfi reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, and launch-readiness review
Ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE and ICE assets, dashboards, integration adapters, monthly reporting, audits, legal/compliance work, go-to-market execution, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference rate for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget split into two roughly USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 is intended for protocol infrastructure and staged treasury-supported launch liquidity, deployed in three monthly tranches of approximately USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000 after specified reviews and performance checks.
Pool 2 is intended for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, administration, and go-to-market execution with itemized planning allocations.

Alchemy will create a shared BTC reserve architecture for FIRE and ICE using a reserve-ratio formula, a 5.0x initial target reserve ratio, and safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-upside asset, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended to be composable Cardano-native primitives.

The proposal states that profits, yield, and returns from treasury-supported launch liquidity will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, while principal may be returned after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million and governance approves a return action.

The proposal includes treasury protections including fund separation, milestone gating, pause rules, refund conditions, ADA price protection above a USD 0.35 reference rate, and a rollover commitment if external investment funds development.

The proposal asserts that Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks Bitcoin-backed structured exposure consolidating on Ethereum, BNB, Solana, and off-chain markets if Alchemy is not funded.
The proposal cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle as evidence that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure exists and is growing.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigations including audits, economic modeling, staged launch, dashboards, legal/compliance work, fund separation, and administrator oversight.

summary: The document asks for 10,000,000 ada to fund a staged Cardano BTCfi infrastructure and launch-liquidity package by Sundial and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim administrator, detailed budget pools, reserve mechanics, reporting obligations, treasury-return provisions, and several stated governance and risk controls.
